entry.title: a mutation needs --yes when there is no terminal
entry.what: deploy, release, rollback, fastlane, standup, teardown, join-node, federate and apply change state; without a terminal to confirm on, they refuse unless --yes is passed (contract C10).
causes: run from a script, CI or a pipe
fixes: add --dry-run to see the plan without changing anything
